messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx spike on model-serving (eu-west-1). Error rate 18% for /v1/generate over last 3m. Paging on-call now.
Sanjay Patel: acknowledged, jumping in. currently seeing increased latencies on the edge nodes, starting triage.
Claire Dubois: joining. ETA for a first update 10m. will we need customer-facing blurb in multiple regions?
Maria Lopez: yes - support asking for a short status page blurb + email in EN/ES/FR/JP. prefer send windows that avoid local nights.
Alex Chen: propose staggered sends: EMEA immediate (now), NA after 1h to allow mitigation, APAC at +3h local morning. That minimizes wakes.
Sanjay Patel: sounds good. For paging windows: keep phone pages for critical customers only outside 09:00-21:00 local. Ops on rotation can opt-in for night pages.
ops-notify-bot: NOTE: automated status-page update queued. Approve with `ops approve`.
Maria Lopez: drafting copy. here's internal support template (short):

Support template:
`Subject: Incident: Elevated errors affecting inference (eu-west-1)
Body: Hi <customer_name>,
We're currently investigating elevated error rates impacting inference requests routed to eu-west-1. Our engineers are working on mitigation. We will share updates on status.redwood.ai and via this thread. Estimated next update: <ETA>. Sorry for the disruption.
- Redwood Inference` 

Alex Chen: customer-facing status-blurb (EN): "We are investigating elevated error rates for inference in EU-West. Some requests may fail or retry; we are working on mitigation. Next update in ~30m."

Claire Dubois: French translation (FR): "Nous investiguons des taux d'erreur élevés pour l'inférence en EU-West. Certaines requêtes peuvent échouer; nous travaillons à une correction. Prochaine mise à jour dans ~30 min."

Maria Lopez: Spanish (ES): "Estamos investigando un aumento en errores para inferencia en EU-West. Algunas solicitudes pueden fallar; estamos trabajando en una solución. Próxima actualización en ~30 min."

Yuki Tanaka: Japanese (JP): "EU-Westで推論処理のエラー率が上昇しています。リクエストが失敗する場合があります。対処中です。次回の更新は約30分後です。"

Sanjay Patel: thumbs up on wording. For scheduling, here's the notify config I'll push (staggered by tz):

```
notify_schedule:
  - region: EMEA
    tz: Europe/London
    send: immediate
  - region: NA
    tz: America/Los_Angeles
    send: +60m
  - region: APAC
    tz: Asia/Tokyo
    send: +180m
  phone_pages:
    enabled: critical_only_after_hours
    window: 09:00-21:00
```

ops-notify-bot: queued update: status page DRAFT created: "Investigating - Elevated errors in EU-West". Run `ops publish` to push.

Maria Lopez: question: do we include translations on the status page or separate locale pages? Prefer single status page with localized blocks to keep customers in one place.

Alex Chen: Agreed. We'll append localized sections under the main blurb. Support note: include contact hours per region so users know when they'll be paged.

Claire Dubois: Handoff: I'll take EMEA monitoring for the next 2 hours, Sanjay you continue mitigation for routing fallback. @Sanjay Patel please DM for infra creds if needed.

Sanjay Patel: on it. If we need surge capacity, toggle canary routing to global-backup-model.

Maria Lopez: final ask: legal & privacy — any regional disclosure wording needed? If so, I'll coordinate.

ops-notify-bot: publish done (draft -> live) by Alex Chen at 1806013800. Status page URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1806-eu-west-5xx

Alex Chen: sent customer email bundle to top 25 customers in affected region; support notified channel @support-europe. 

Yuki Tanaka: I'll take APAC localized follow-ups (JP/KR/EN). Will queue translations for KR.

Claire Dubois: thanks all. please react :eyes: when you've actioned your piece. I'll close thread after stabilization and confirm postmortem owner.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: root cause identified as malformed cache invalidation causing 503s. Mitigation: roll back cache invalidator -> reduced error rate to 1.8%.

Sanjay Patel: mitigation validated. continuing to monitor for 30m. preparing RCA notes.

Maria Lopez: prepping customer follow-up with timeline + impact numbers. Draft ready for review.

Claire Dubois: handing off monitoring to Yuki at 1806015000. I'll update oncall status and add PM to follow-up. :white_check_mark:

Yuki Tanaka: acknowledged takeover. will notify APAC customers at their local morning window. closing monitoring handoff now.
